personas.label: Sanne, 34, webshop owner, Utrecht
personas.situation: Runs a Shopify shop (homeware and gifts) alone or with one packer. Posts at 23:00 when she remembers; boosted a post once and never knew what it brought in. December is make-or-break.
words: Ik post als ik eraan denk.
Ik weet niet wat die advertenties opleveren.

personas.label: Joris, 41, café-lunchroom owner, Haarlem
personas.situation: Closes at six and does Instagram after. Knows reels work, never films them. Quiet Tuesdays, a new winter menu, locals and day-trippers.
words: Om zes uur dicht, en dan moet Instagram nog.

personas.vertical: salons (hair, nails, massage; non-medical) and local services
personas.label: Fatima, 38, salon owner, Rotterdam
personas.situation: Hair and nails, three chairs. Gaps midweek, full Saturdays. No time for content between clients; wants her page to sound like her salon, not like a chain.
words: Mijn agenda moet vol, niet mijn avond.

personas.label: Declan, 45, plumbing and heating, Cork
personas.situation: Three vans, work mostly by word of mouth, which is uneven. Jobs done, nothing posted. Boiler season is when a steady page would pay.
words: I'm under a sink all day.
Posting is the last thing on my mind.

personas.label: Aoife, 37, café with rooms, near Galway
personas.situation: Summer sells itself, November does not. Wants Christmas bookings and locals midweek; has the photos on her website but no time for reels.

personas.label: Niamh, 42, physiotherapy clinic owner, Limerick
personas.situation: Owns a four-room physio clinic. Worried about health ad rules and anything going out that overclaims. A new clinician starts in January; slots to fill.
words: I can't have anything going out that says something it shouldn't.

pains.text: Posting when you remember: no plan, the page goes quiet for weeks
Reels work, but there is no evening to film, cut and caption them
Ads spend money and nobody says plainly what came back
AI tools still leave the idea, the prompt, the fixing and the posting to you
Copy that reads like a translation, or like it was written for another country
Fear that software posts something wrong in your name

objections.text: Will it look fake or say something wrong?
objections.answer: Nothing goes out without your tap; Otto builds on your own website; regulated claims get a compliance hold.
Otto reads your site, prices and competitors and asks at most four questions; every skip and edit teaches it.
Written in Dutch for your town, not translated from English.

objections.text: I don't want to pay for something I haven't tried.
objections.answer: 7 days free, no card; nothing is charged automatically. Prefer to pay once: the founding pilot, €197.
Official Meta login, revocable any time; Otto never sees your password.
Ads show numbers in week one, organic in 60-90 days; the 07:35 report shows both every morning.

offers.name: Free trial
offers.terms: Sign in with Google, no card; one trial per business and per website. Otto sets up from the website: the first week of posts, stories and reels, approvals by e-mail, in Telegram or in the app, the 07:35 report, paid ads planned for preview (they launch once a plan is chosen). E-mail two days before the end; nothing is charged automatically; the brand pauses if no plan is chosen.

offers.name: Founding pilot (pay once)
offers.terms: The landing's 'Prefer to pay once?' option through Whop: a pilot month with Growth features; setup and founding terms carry over. Capped at 50 seats; show a seats-left count only when it is the live number.

proof_bank.claim: At 07:35 every morning Otto tells you what yesterday cost and what it brought in.
Founding pilot (pay once): €197 once, excl. VAT, for 50 posts, 12 stories and 4 explainer reels for one brand.
The first posts are ready for approval within 24 hours of sign-up.
Nothing goes out without your approval; every post waits for your tap.
Otto reads your website, builds your brand profile and asks you at most four questions.
About 30 minutes of your time each week.
Alerts within the hour when something drops, with a fix already drafted.
Social accounts connect once through their official login; access can be revoked at any time.
Otto writes client content in Dutch, English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese and Hebrew.
Reels are made from the business's own website (4 a month on Starter and in the founding pilot).
Free for 7 days: sign in with Google, no card, nothing is charged automatically.

cta_by_stage.cold: Scan your website: free, no signup (LEARN_MORE)
cta_by_stage.warm: See what Otto reads from your site (LEARN_MORE)
cta_by_stage.hot: Start free 7-day trial (SIGN_UP); pay-once alternative: founding pilot €197

targets.notes: cpl = cost per scan result shown (the Lead event), target €8 at launch (EU-LAUNCH §5.3: CPC €0.9-1.7, 15-25% of visitors scan). cpa = cost per paying founder, plan with €150-300 (target €225). See docs/GO-TO-MARKET-NL-IE.md.

angles.angle: Your website, as a reel: reels work, nobody has an evening to film them; Otto makes them from the site
The 7:35 message: one message every morning with what yesterday cost and what it brought in, and what waits for your tap
Local, not translated: copy written in the owner's language for their town, against generic tools that translate
For owners who would rather run the business than post about it: you tap yes, Otto does the rest
The free 7-day trial: sign in with Google, no card, first posts within 24 hours; founding pilot €197 as the pay-once alternative
December planned in November: Sinterklaas and Christmas (NL), the Christmas season (IE), approved before the rush
